data.one_liner: Shared layer for MediaPipe task packages providing platform engines, downloads, and model store.
data.what_it_does: Acts as a foundational shared layer for MediaPipe task packages. Handles verified downloads, an on-demand model store, browser runtimes, and engine setup across multiple platforms.
use_when: You are using MediaPipe task packages that require the core runtime layer.
You need to bundle or download MediaPipe models with SHA-256 verification.
avoid_when: You are not using any MediaPipe task packages in your application.
strengths: Provides verified downloads with SHA-256 checks for models.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Not intended to be added or imported directly unless your own code explicitly requires `package:mediapipe_core/...`.
data.setup_notes: Added automatically via MediaPipe task packages, or manually if writing direct core code. May require platform permissions depending on model store downloads.
